correctness.rationale: For smooth Banach norms the derivative of half squared distance gives the necessary and sufficient normal-cone inequality for metric projection. The pointwise test is a two-sided consequence using 0 and p in K. Global residual idempotence forces 0 in K and, for every y in K and t>1, writes ty=p+r with <J(r),p>=0 and <J(r),y><=0; hence ||r||^2<=0 and ty in K. Conicity conversely uses 0,2p to force <J(r),p>=0, whence P_K r=0. Quantifiers, zero residues, absence of continuity assumptions, and bounded/nonreflexive settings are addressed explicitly.

value.rationale: A 2026 study explicitly examines when I-P_K is idempotent but establishes necessary conditions only. The complete smooth-Banach convex-Chebyshev iff resolves the natural associated structural classification without pointedness, solidity, or Hilbert assumptions. The pointwise duality pairing identifies the precise obstruction. The result is valuable as a natural classification, not by proof complexity or merely by novelty.
